turns.patient_opening: Hi. I’m 59. I’ve had a fever and a cough for a while, and I’ve also been coughing up blood. I’ve lost weight without trying too, and I’m also diabetic—I take corticosteroids—and I drink alcohol heavily and use IV drugs.

turns.doctor_question:
What color is the rash?  
For example: **red, pink, dark, pale, yellow**, or is it **absent**?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t have a rash. It’s absent.

turns.doctor_question: To help with your medical history, have you ever smoked in the past but quit (a former smoker)?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t know / I’m not sure. I can’t say if I was a former smoker.

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel any pain somewhere in your upper middle abdomen (the area just below your breastbone)?
turns.patient_answer: No, I don’t have pain there.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any family members (such as a parent, sibling, or child) who have had lung cancer?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t know. My family history is unknown to me.

turns.doctor_question: Do you get exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke every day (for example, from someone smoking in the home, car, or nearby at work)?
turns.patient_answer: No, I don’t have daily exposure to secondhand smoke that I know of.

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel any pain somewhere in your throat (pharynx) right now—yes or no?
In the last month, have you been in contact with anyone who was infected with the Ebola virus? (Yes or no)
